mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.5% over two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when GDPC1 YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly unemployment rate increase of at least 0.3 percentage points over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises by ≥0.3pp for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods of three consecutive months with UNRATE rising ≥0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% signals contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces earnings for industrial firms and drags down the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) when INDPRO falls by >0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decline in both personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based weakening in demand, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline month-over-month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is cut by at least 0.75% within a quarter, liquidity conditions ease substantially, lowering risk premia and boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) following a quarterly FEDFUNDS decline of ≥0.75%.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly increase of at least 0.4% in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for four consecutive months signals a manufacturing expansion, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises by ≥0.4% for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of four consecutive months with INDPRO rising ≥0.4%.
